claimScope: Correctness and observational regression evidence only; no percentile or throughput-improvement claim.
selectionRule: Keep every nonblank JSON row whose metric starts with case-sensitive 'FileOps.' and does not start with 'FileOps.Popup.'; no additional FileSystemCopy metrics exist in raw input.
byteRule: Each selected original UTF-8 line including its original line-ending bytes; concatenated in increasing original line order, partitioned only at original line boundaries.
